# netcup_clouddns_record (Resource)

A DNS record of a domain on CloudDNS (netcup API). Each change is one changeset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_domain" "example" {
  fqdn = "example.com"
}

resource "netcup_clouddns_record" "www" {
  domain_id = data.netcup_clouddns_domain.example.id
  name      = "www"
  type      = "A"
  rdata     = "192.0.2.10"
  ttl       = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Id of the domain, from the `netcup_clouddns_domain` data source.
- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone, e.g. `www`, `@` for the apex or `*` as wildcard label.
- `rdata` (String) Record data in zone file format, e.g. an IP address, `priority hostname` for `MX` or `priority weight port target` for `SRV`.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds.
- `type` (String) Record type, e.g. `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id `domain_id/name/type/rdata`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <domain_id>/<name>/<type>/<rdata>
terraform import netcup_clouddns_record.www 12345/www/A/192.0.2.10
```
